The part is $24,$ the percentage is $30%,$ and we need to find the whole.

To do this, we can use the following formula:

$$
\text{whole}=\text{part}÷\text{percentage}
$$

Before we can substitute our numbers into the formula, we need to express $30%$ as a fraction:

$$
\frac{30}{100}=\frac{30÷10}{100÷10}=\frac{3}{10}
$$

We can now substitute our numbers into the formula, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{whole} & =24÷30% \\  & =24÷\frac{3}{10} \\  & =24\times \frac{10}{3} \\  & =\frac{24}{3}\times 10 \\  & =8\times 10 \\  & =80\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $80\times 30%=24.$
